Benefits Candidates Preparation Recovery Results Cost FAQs Consultation Facial Volume, Defined What Are Dermal Fillers? Dermal fillers are injectable treatments that restore volume, smooth out wrinkles, and refine facial contours . These minimally invasive injections are placed in the deeper layers of the skin to fill areas that have lost fullness due to age or weight changes. Most fillers are made with hyaluronic acid, a substance naturally found in the body that attracts water and helps maintain youthful, smoother skin. Today, injectable dermal fillers are among the most popular cosmetic procedures in the U.S., offering natural looking results without the need for plastic surgery. Many patients choose fillers to enhance their features, correct asymmetry, and achieve a more balanced, youthful appearance. JuvÃ©derm Juvederm products are some of the most commonly used dermal fillers in our Weston office. This versatile family of injectables is made with hyaluronic acid and includes specific formulations for lip augmentation, smoothing facial lines, lifting sagging skin, and restoring volume to the cheeks. Whether youâre targeting nasolabial folds, marionette lines, or simply want more defined lips, JuvÃ©derm is often a popular choice for optimal results. Restylane Restylane fillers are excellent for addressing fine lines, thin lips, and under-eye hollows. Products like Restylane Silk are designed with softer textures for delicate areas, helping to smooth and hydrate the skin without adding bulk. This injectable line also uses hyaluronic acid and is frequently used for enhancing the lips, cheeks, and folds around the mouth. Sculptra Sculptra differs from hyaluronic acid fillers. Instead of instantly filling areas, it stimulates your bodyâs own collagen production to gradually restore facial volume. This makes it a great option for deep lines, sagging skin, and larger areas needing contour and lift. Patients often notice improvements over several months, depending on their skinâs natural response. Smooth, Soft, and Precise Benefits of Dermal Fillers Injectable fillers provide a customizable, temporary way to improve the appearance of aging skin without surgery or long downtime . Whether you want to correct frown lines or add volume to the lips, fillers are a versatile tool that can be used alone or combined with other injectables like Botox for more comprehensive results. Dermal Filler Benefits may include: Fuller, more balanced lips (lip augmentation) Smoother skin with fewer facial lines and wrinkles Lifted, youthful cheeks Softened nasolabial folds and marionette lines Enhanced jawline and chin contour Volume restoration in hands or other common areas No general anesthesia, incisions, or lengthy recovery More Than Just Lips & Lines What Areas of the Body Can Be Treated With Dermal Fillers? Injectable dermal fillers can be used to enhance many parts of the face and body. These are the most common areas we treat in our Weston-area office: Lips A popular choice for patients looking to define, hydrate, or subtly plump the lips. Lip fillers can also correct thin lips or asymmetry and help achieve smoother skin texture around the mouth. Cheeks Cheek fillers help restore lost facial volume and contour the midface. Many patients find this gives the whole face a more lifted, refreshed appearance. Under Eyes This area is prone to hollows and dark circles with age. Injecting fillers here can brighten the face and reduce signs of fatigue without the need for surgery. Jawline Filler injections in the jawline can sharpen and define the lower face, offering a more structured and youthful appearance. Chin Chin filler is ideal for patients with a recessed or uneven chin. It balances facial proportions and is often used with jawline filler for best results. Temples Loss of volume here can cause the face to look older or more hollow. A small amount of filler restores fullness and supports the brow area. Hands Hands often show signs of aging before the face. Fillers can reduce the look of veins and tendons, making the skin appear smoother and more youthful. Is This for You? Dermal Fillers Candidates Many patients are surprised by how accessible injectable fillers can be. If you're over 21, in good health, and want to address signs of aging like deep lines, sagging skin, or thin lips, you may be a good dermal filler candidate . During your appointment, our doctors will assess your skin, facial structure, and goals to ensure the treatment is right for you. Patients who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or have certain allergies may be advised to delay treatment. We'll always prioritize your safety and comfort. What We Can Smooth and Lift What Issues Can Dermal Fillers Address? Injectables can do more than just soften wrinkles. They help with volume loss, contour imbalances, and signs of aging that develop over time. These are some of the most common concerns our Weston Dermal Filler patients treat with dermal fillers: Nasolabial Folds These folds run from the sides of the nose to the mouth. Filler helps to soften these deep lines and smooth the midface area. Marionette Lines These lines pull downward from the corners of the mouth, creating a tired or sad expression. Fillers can lift and fill this area for a more relaxed look. Thin Lips Some patients are born with naturally thin lips, while others lose volume with age. Lip augmentation with hyaluronic acid fillers adds shape and definition without overdoing it. Hollow Cheeks or Temples Loss of volume in these areas can cause a sunken or drawn appearance. Fillers help restore fullness and structure. Under-Eye Hollows This delicate area can be brightened and smoothed using soft fillers, reducing the appearance of dark circles and fatigue. Weak Chin or Jawline Filler can improve contour and definition, especially when sagging or uneven structure is present. Aging Hands Volume loss in the hands makes veins and tendons more visible. Fillers bring back softness and smoothness to this overlooked area. Start With a Plan Consultation and Preparation Your first visit is more than a quick walkthrough. We take time to understand what youâre hoping to achieve and how you want to feel after treatment. Dr. Nily Abramovitz and Dr. Alla Agamov will sit down with you in a comfortable, no-pressure setting to discuss your concerns, answer questions, and explore which injectable dermal fillers are best for your goals. Before your appointment, we may recommend pausing certain medications or supplements that can increase the risk of bruising or swelling. Prior to injections with dermal filler Weston patients will receive personalized prep instructions so they feel informed and ready. In, Out, Gorgeous Your Dermal Fillers Treatment Injections are performed right in our Newton office and typically take 30 to 45 minutes. We use a topical numbing cream to minimize discomfort, and many fillers also include lidocaine for added comfort. Most patients report only mild pressure or tenderness during the procedure. Our doctors take a conservative, skilled approach to each injection, always aiming for natural-looking dermal filler results . Youâll be given time to check your results and ask questions before leaving. Healing Without Downtime Dermal Filler Recovery and Aftercare Dermal Filler recovery is usually simple and quick . Some temporary swelling, redness, tenderness, or bruising can occur at the injection sites, but these effects typically resolve within a few days. We recommend avoiding alcohol and strenuous activity for the first 24 to 48 hours and keeping the area clean. You should also wait to apply makeup until any redness has subsided. Our team will provide you with detailed aftercare guidance tailored to your treatment. Weâll walk you through your aftercare instructions and whatâs normal to expect. Instant (Mostly), Lasting (Definitely) Dermal Fillers Results Weston Dermal Filler patients should see results immediately after the procedure. Some improvement will continue to develop over the first few days as swelling settles. In the case of Sculptra, collagen production builds over time, giving gradual, long-lasting improvement. Depending on the type of filler used and the area treated, results can last anywhere from several months to two years. Maintenance appointments are recommended to keep your results consistent and fresh. Worth It (Really) How Much Do Dermal Fillers Cost? The cost of dermal fillers varies based on the product, area treated, and amount of filler needed. Dermal Fillers Frequently Asked Questions Are Dermal Fillers painful? Most patients feel only mild discomfort. We apply numbing cream and use fine needles to minimize sensation. Are Dermal Fillers safe? Yes, when injected by trained specialists using FDA-approved substances. Side effects like swelling or bruising may occur, but are usually minor and temporary. How long do the results of Dermal Fillers last? Dermal Filler results can last several months , depending on the filler type, injection area, and how your body metabolizes the product. Can I combine Dermal Fillers with other cosmetic treatments? Absolutely. Fillers are commonly combined with Botox or skin treatments like microneedling to enhance overall results. How soon will I see Dermal Fillers results? Most patients see results immediately, with continued improvement over a few days as swelling resolves.
